title: trifolium minus var. microphyllum
intro: Trifolium minus var. microphyllum, commonly known as small-flowered bitter clover, is a variety of the Trifolium minus plant, belonging to the legume family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Trifolium minus var. microphyllum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
